{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not fully specified",
      "quote": "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the ORR as determined by central review.",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is stated but the statistical analysis section does not explicitly describe the analysis method (e.g., exact binomial CI) for the primary endpoint, though it is implied in sample size justification. The estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) are not fully specified.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed estimand and analysis method for the primary endpoint in the statistical plan."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack analysis details",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: Duration of response, PFS, OS, CR rate, ...",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoints are listed but the statistical plan does not describe how each will be analyzed (e.g., Kaplan-Meier for PFS/OS, methods for DOR, CR rate).",
      "fix": "Provide analysis methods for each secondary endpoint in the statistical plan."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of intercurrent events for PFS/OS",
      "quote": "Progression-free survival (PFS) by central and investigator review",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for PFS and OS does not specify how intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, subsequent therapy) are handled.",
      "fix": "Define intercurrent event strategies for PFS and OS estimands."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for quality of life endpoints",
      "quote": "Change in scores of patient-reported outcomes in the EORTC QLQ-C30 and the Skindex-16",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe how the QoL endpoints will be analyzed, including missing data handling.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for QoL endpoints, including handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK and immunogenicity endpoints",
      "quote": "Concentrations of cemiplimab in serum (at select sites)",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe how PK and immunogenicity data will be analyzed.",
      "fix": "Include analysis methods for PK and immunogenicity endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack analysis details",
      "quote": "The following exploratory analyses are planned: Associations between tumor non-synonymous mutational burden at baseline and efficacy of cemiplimab",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis methods are described for them.",
      "fix": "Provide analysis methods for exploratory endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: Duration of response, PFS, OS, CR rate, ...",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "No mention of multiplicity adjustment for multiple secondary endpoints, which could inflate Type I error.",
      "fix": "Specify multiplicity control strategy for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency in stopping rule",
      "quote": "If accrual to Group 1 is <16 patients in 6 months, Group 1 will be closed for inability to achieve target accrual.",
      "page": 83,
      "section": "10.2 Justification of Sample Size",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The stopping rule uses a threshold of 16 patients, but the sample size for Group 1 is 50 (or 53 with inflation). The rule may be inconsistent with the target accrual rate implied by the sample size.",
      "fix": "Clarify the rationale for the 16-patient threshold in relation to the target sample size."
    }
  ]
}
